title_en: NASA’s Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory to burn up this week after more than two decades in space
summary_en: As of Monday, the U.S. Space Force predicted Swift would re-enter Earth's atmosphere at approximately 3:30 a.m. EST Wednesday, Nov. 4, somewhere within about 21 degrees north or south of the equator — a band that is mostly ocean.
